verdict.rationale: Rippling's own IAM marketing says it provisions or revokes access based on risk signals and company policy. It also says it enforces custom security policies built on user and device attributes, which gives thin support for context-driven access decisions. Nothing documents conditional policies at sign-in time that weigh network or location, or that can be scoped per app and per group. missing for 10: network/IP-based conditions, location/geo conditions, explicit device-posture gating at authentication, per-app and per-group conditional policy configuration, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access decisions weigh context — network, device, location, and risk signals drive conditional policies per app and group
